# Manuel Gil

> Building and carrying open source tools over time. Some are active, some are quiet, all are published with responsibility.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://imgil.dev/): Software developer and open source maintainer building and carrying developer tools over time.
- [About](https://imgil.dev/about): Background, what I actually work on, and the tools and languages I use.
- [Open Source Projects](https://imgil.dev/open-source-projects): A selection of the open source work I've done - VS Code extensions, a Debian-based distribution, PHP and Moodle tooling, and Windows repair scripts.
- [Talks & Communities](https://imgil.dev/talks-communities): Talks and events where I've shared what I've learned about open source and the tools I've built.
- [Support](https://imgil.dev/support): How to support the ongoing maintenance of the open source tools I carry.

## Blog

- [Blog Index](https://imgil.dev/blog): Notes on building and carrying open source tools.
- [Getting Started with Web Development](https://imgil.dev/blog/mi-primer-post): A comprehensive guide to starting your journey in web development, covering essential technologies and best practices.
- [Optimizing Astro Sites for Performance](https://imgil.dev/blog/optimizing-astro-sites): Learn how to improve Core Web Vitals and overall performance in your Astro projects.
